UpdateStageName: Run PostgreSQL with fail-closed TLS selection
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Settings=postgresql/settings; Base=$(<\"$Settings/base-dir\"); Port=$(<\"$Settings/port\"); ListenAddress=$(<\"$Settings/listen-address\"); TLSHostname=$(<\"$Settings/tls-hostname\"); [[ \"$Base\" == /*/ && \"$Base\" != *$'\n'* && \"$Base\" != *$'\r'* ]] || { echo 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$Port\" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((Port >= 1 && Port <= 65535)) || { echo 'Invalid PostgreSQL port'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$ListenAddress\" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F:.,]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid listen address'; exit 1; }; cd \"$Base\"; if pgsql/bin/pg_isready --host=\"${Base}run\" --port=\"$Port\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Refusing to treat an existing socket responder as this managed PostgreSQL instance'; exit 1; fi; Cert=\"${Base}tls/server.crt\"; Key=\"${Base}tls/server.key\"; TLSArgs=(--ssl=off); if [[ -s \"$Cert\" || -s \"$Key\" ]]; then [[ -s \"$Cert\" && -s \"$Key\" ]] || { echo 'Both server.crt and server.key are required'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$TLSHostname\" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$ && \"$TLSHostname\" != 'REPLACE_BEFORE_TLS_USE' ]] || { echo 'A valid exact TLS hostname is required'; exit 1; }; KeyMode=$(stat -c '%a' \"$Key\"); KeyOwner=$(stat -c '%u' \"$Key\"); [[ \"$KeyMode\" == '600' ]] || { echo 'server.key must have mode 0600'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$KeyOwner\" == \"$(id -u)\" ]] || { echo 'server.key must be owned by the PostgreSQL service identity'; exit 1; }; openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -checkhost \"$TLSHostname\"; openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -checkend 86400; NotBefore=$(openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -startdate | cut -d= -f2-); [[ $(date -d \"$NotBefore\" +%s) -le $(date +%s) ]] || { echo 'Certificate is not yet valid'; exit 1; }; CertKeyHash=$(openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); PrivateKeyHash=$(openssl pkey -passin pass: -in \"$Key\" -pubout -outform DER | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); [[ \"$CertKeyHash\" == \"$PrivateKeyHash\" ]] || { echo 'Certificate and private key do not match'; exit 1; }; openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname \"$TLSHostname\" -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt -untrusted \"$Cert\" \"$Cert\"; TLSArgs=(--ssl=on --ssl_cert_file=\"$Cert\" --ssl_key_file=\"$Key\" --ssl_min_protocol_version=TLSv1.2); echo 'Certificate identity, validity, chain, ownership and key match passed'; else echo 'TLS certificate absent: local administration only; HBA rejects every remote plaintext connection'; fi; pgsql/bin/postgres -D \"${Base}data\" -p \"$Port\" -k \"${Base}run\" --external_pid_file=\"${Base}run/postgres.pid\" --listen_addresses=\"$ListenAddress\" \"${TLSArgs[@]}\" &"

UpdateStageName: Verify exact PostgreSQL instance and TLS state
UpdateSourceArgs: -c 'set -euo pipefail; Settings=postgresql/settings; Base=$(<"$Settings/base-dir"); Port=$(<"$Settings/port"); ExpectedVersion=$(<"$Settings/version"); AllowedRole=$(<"$Settings/allowed-role"); AdminRole=$(<"$Settings/admin-role"); CommercialDatabase=$(<"$Settings/commercial-database"); CommercialRuntimeRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-runtime-role"); CommercialAuthorizerRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-authorizer-role"); CommercialMigratorRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migrator-role"); Pending="${Base}data/pg_hba.remote.pending"; Hba="${Base}data/pg_hba.conf"; fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }; cleanup_on_error() { Status=$?; trap - EXIT; if ((Status != 0)) && [[ -x "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_ctl" && -f "${Base}data/postmaster.pid" ]]; then "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_ctl" -D "${Base}data" -m immediate stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; exit "$Status"; }; trap cleanup_on_error EXIT; timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_isready" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; ((timeout>=0)) || fail '"'"'PostgreSQL failed to start'"'"'; Info=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --field-separator='"'"'|'"'"' --command="SELECT current_setting('"'"'server_version'"'"'), current_setting('"'"'data_directory'"'"'), current_setting('"'"'port'"'"'), current_setting('"'"'unix_socket_directories'"'"'), current_setting('"'"'ssl'"'"')"); IFS='"'"'|'"'"' read -r ServerVersion DataDirectory ServerPort SocketDirectories SSLState <<< "$Info"; [[ "$ServerVersion" == "$ExpectedVersion" ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL server version'"'"'; [[ $(realpath "$DataDirectory") == $(realpath "${Base}data") ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL data directory'"'"'; [[ "$ServerPort" == "$Port" ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL port'"'"'; [[ "$SocketDirectories" == *"${Base}run"* ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL socket directory'"'"'; PostmasterPid=$(head -n1 "${Base}data/postmaster.pid") || fail '"'"'Could not read PostgreSQL postmaster PID'"'"'; [[ "$PostmasterPid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail '"'"'Invalid PostgreSQL postmaster PID'"'"'; ExpectedExecutable=$(readlink -f "${Base}pgsql/bin/postgres") || fail '"'"'Could not resolve expected PostgreSQL executable'"'"'; ActualExecutable=$(readlink -f "/proc/${PostmasterPid}/exe") || fail '"'"'Could not resolve running PostgreSQL executable'"'"'; [[ "$ActualExecutable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL executable'"'"'; if [[ -s "${Base}tls/server.crt" ]]; then [[ "$SSLState" == '"'"'on'"'"' ]] || fail '"'"'TLS certificate is present but PostgreSQL SSL is not on'"'"'; else [[ "$SSLState" == '"'"'off'"'"' ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL SSL state'"'"'; fi; PreflightInfo=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --field-separator='"'"'|'"'"' --command="SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE type = '"'"'hostssl'"'"'), (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE error IS NOT NULL)"); IFS='"'"'|'"'"' read -r PreflightHostsslCount PreflightHbaErrors <<< "$PreflightInfo"; [[ "$PreflightHostsslCount" == 0 && "$PreflightHbaErrors" == 0 ]] || fail '"'"'PostgreSQL did not start with the local-only preflight HBA'"'"'; is_placeholder() { case "$1" in REPLACE_BEFORE_REMOTE_USE|REPLACE_ADMIN_BEFORE_REMOTE_USE|REPLACE_COMMERCIAL_RUNTIME_ROLE|REPLACE_COMMERCIAL_AUTHORIZER_ROLE|REPLACE_COMMERCIAL_MIGRATOR_ROLE) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac; }; role_info() { local Role=$1; "${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --field-separator='"'"'|'"'"' --command="SELECT rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolreplication, rolcreatedb, rolcreaterole, rolcanlogin, oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '"'"'$Role'"'"'"; }; validate_role_posture() { local Label=$1 Role=$2 Policy=$3 RoleInfo Super Bypass Replication CreateDb CreateRole CanLogin Oid MembershipCount DangerousMembershipCount DangerousPredicate; RoleInfo=$(role_info "$Role"); if is_placeholder "$Role"; then [[ -z "$RoleInfo" ]] || fail "$Label placeholder role must not exist"; return 0; fi; [[ -n "$RoleInfo" ]] || fail "$Label role does not exist"; IFS='"'"'|'"'"' read -r Super Bypass Replication CreateDb CreateRole CanLogin Oid <<< "$RoleInfo"; [[ "$Super" == f && "$Bypass" == f && "$Replication" == f ]] || fail "$Label role has forbidden superuser, bypass-RLS or replication privileges"; DangerousPredicate='"'"'pg_roles.rolsuper OR pg_roles.rolbypassrls OR pg_roles.rolreplication'"'"'; if [[ "$Policy" == primary || "$Policy" == migrator ]]; then DangerousPredicate="$DangerousPredicate OR pg_roles.rolcreatedb OR pg_roles.rolcreaterole"; fi; DangerousMembershipCount=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --command="WITH RECURSIVE reachable(oid) AS (SELECT roleid FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member = $Oid UNION SELECT memberships.roleid FROM pg_auth_members memberships JOIN reachable ON memberships.member = reachable.oid) SELECT count(*) FROM reachable JOIN pg_roles ON pg_roles.oid = reachable.oid WHERE $DangerousPredicate"); [[ "$DangerousMembershipCount" == 0 ]] || fail "$Label role can reach a superuser, bypass-RLS or replication role through membership"; case "$Policy" in admin) [[ "$CanLogin" == t ]] || fail '"'"'Administrative role must have LOGIN'"'"' ;; primary) [[ "$CreateDb" == f && "$CreateRole" == f && "$CanLogin" == t ]] || fail "$Label role must have LOGIN, NOCREATEDB and NOCREATEROLE" ;; commercial) [[ "$CreateDb" == f && "$CreateRole" == f && "$CanLogin" == t ]] || fail "$Label role must have LOGIN, NOCREATEDB and NOCREATEROLE"; MembershipCount=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --command="SELECT count(*) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE member = $Oid"); [[ "$MembershipCount" == 0 ]] || fail "$Label role must not inherit or SET ROLE through role memberships" ;; migrator) [[ "$CreateDb" == f && "$CreateRole" == f && "$CanLogin" == f ]] || fail '"'"'Commercial migrator must be NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE and NOLOGIN at startup'"'"' ;; esac; }; validate_role_posture '"'"'Primary application'"'"' "$AllowedRole" primary; validate_role_posture '"'"'Administrative'"'"' "$AdminRole" admin; validate_role_posture '"'"'Commercial runtime'"'"' "$CommercialRuntimeRole" commercial; validate_role_posture '"'"'Commercial authorizer'"'"' "$CommercialAuthorizerRole" commercial; validate_role_posture '"'"'Commercial migrator'"'"' "$CommercialMigratorRole" migrator; if ! is_placeholder "$CommercialRuntimeRole" || ! is_placeholder "$CommercialAuthorizerRole"; then DatabaseOwner=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --command="SELECT datdba FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '"'"'$CommercialDatabase'"'"'"); [[ -n "$DatabaseOwner" ]] || fail '"'"'Commercial database does not exist'"'"'; RuntimeOid=$(role_info "$CommercialRuntimeRole" | cut -d'"'"'|'"'"' -f7); AuthorizerOid=$(role_info "$CommercialAuthorizerRole" | cut -d'"'"'|'"'"' -f7); [[ "$RuntimeOid" != "$DatabaseOwner" && "$AuthorizerOid" != "$DatabaseOwner" ]] || fail '"'"'Commercial runtime and authorizer must not own the commercial database'"'"'; fi; [[ -f "$Pending" && $(stat -c '"'"'%a'"'"' "$Pending") == 600 ]] || fail '"'"'Validated pending HBA file is missing or has an unsafe mode'"'"'; umask 077; HbaNext=$(mktemp "${Base}data/.pg_hba.conf.XXXXXX"); cp -- "$Pending" "$HbaNext"; chmod 0600 "$HbaNext"; mv -f "$HbaNext" "$Hba"; Reloaded=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --command='"'"'SELECT pg_reload_conf()'"'"'); [[ "$Reloaded" == t ]] || fail '"'"'PostgreSQL did not accept the HBA reload request'"'"'; timeout=10; while ((timeout--)); do HbaInfo=$("${Base}pgsql/bin/psql" --host="${Base}run" --port="$Port" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --field-separator='"'"'|'"'"' --command="SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE type = '"'"'hostssl'"'"'), (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE error IS NOT NULL), (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE type = '"'"'hostssl'"'"' AND error = '"'"'hostssl record cannot match because SSL is disabled'"'"')"); IFS='"'"'|'"'"' read -r HostsslCount HbaErrors DisabledHostsslErrors <<< "$HbaInfo"; [[ "$HostsslCount" == 10 ]] && break || sleep 1; done; [[ "$HostsslCount" == 10 ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL hostssl rule count'"'"'; if [[ "$SSLState" == off ]]; then [[ "$HbaErrors" == 10 && "$DisabledHostsslErrors" == 10 ]] || fail '"'"'Unexpected PostgreSQL HBA diagnostics in local-only TLS mode'"'"'; else [[ "$HbaErrors" == 0 ]] || fail '"'"'PostgreSQL rejected one or more HBA rules'"'"'; fi; trap - EXIT; echo "Exact PostgreSQL instance, role posture and TLS readiness passed; server_version=$ServerVersion ssl=$SSLState"'
